40001.name: Bhogawati
40001.why: Wikipedia: rises on the Balaghat scarp near Dharashiv (Osmanabad), flows ~65 km SW through Barshi and Madha talukas and joins the Sina near Mohol - matches source, course, length and mouth. CWC's three 'Bhogavati/Bhogawati' lines are different rivers (Kolhapur, Tapi and Godavari basins). Catchment 1,647 km2 - the largest humid-zone gap found.

40025.name: Oshiwara
40025.why: Mumbai river from the Aarey hills to Malad Creek, absent from CWC. Course from the OpenStreetMap "Oshiwara River" ways, ending where it meets the Malad Creek channel (drawn by CWC as the lower Poisar, uid 9009).

40026.name: Vakola Nala
40026.why: Rises north of Santacruz East and joins the Mithi (CWC "Mahim") just above Mahim Creek. OSM names it "Vakola Nala" (water area 39749207); the line follows the unnamed OSM waterways along it.

40027.name: Mahul Creek
40027.why: From the Ghatkopar West hills through Vidyavihar, Shell Colony and Kurla East, then south past Chunabhatti and Wadala along Mahul Road into Mumbai Harbour; the stretch past Antop Hill is the Mumbai City / Suburban district boundary. Unnamed in OSM; "Mahul Creek" is the name of its tidal outlet.

40028.why: Unnamed. Rises in the Ghatkopar hills near R City Mall, runs through Ghatkopar East and along the north edge of the Deonar dumping ground into Thane Creek. Unnamed OSM waterways.

40029.name: Desai Khadi (north branch)
40029.why: Northern headstream of the Desai Khadi, from the hills south of Ambernath to the junction by the Taloja Bypass.

40030.name: Desai Khadi (south branch)
40030.why: Southern headstream of the Desai Khadi, from the hills south of Ambernath to the junction by the Taloja Bypass.

40031.name: Desai Khadi
40031.why: Formed by its two branches by the Taloja Bypass, flows west past Nilaje and Desai village, south of Diva, and north into the Ulhas near Mumbra. OSM way 204366002 and neighbours (unnamed); Desai village sits on its bank.

40032.name: Chena
40032.why: OSM "Chena River": from the Yeoor hills of Sanjay Gandhi National Park north to the Ulhas (Vasai Creek) at Ghodbunder.

40033.name: Waldhuni
40033.why: OSM "Waldhuni River" and "Wadhuni": from near Ambernath through Ulhasnagar to the Ulhas at Shahad, Kalyan. OSM maps only its lower course.

40034.name: Irla Nala
40034.why: OSM "Irla Nala": from Vile Parle west through Irla to the sea at Juhu.

40035.name: Mogara Nallah
40035.why: OSM "Mogara Nallah": through Andheri West to Malad Creek near Lokhandwala.

40036.name: Chandansar
40036.why: Unmapped in OSM; HydroRIVERS course from the hills east of the Jivdani temple, Virar, north past Chandansar village (on Chandansar Road) to the Vaitarna. Name as the user gave it.

40037.name: Somaiyya Nalla
40037.why: OSM "Somaiyya Nalla": rises at Tilak Nagar, about 1 km from Lokmanya Tilak Terminus, runs east under the Eastern Express Highway, along the Ghatkopar-Mankhurd Link Road and east to the unnamed river at the north-west corner of the Deonar dumping ground; their joint channel reaches Thane Creek.
